Senator Sought Water Funding That Could Benefit His Ranch

Senator Roger Marshall requested $4.2 million for a project to increase water flow to a wildlife refuge, a move a watchdog group identified as a potential conflict of interest. The group stated the senator should have recused himself from the matter. The project could also benefit Marshall's ranch.
